name: Benqi
description: BENQI is a leading DeFi application on the Avalanche network that offers a suite of protocols for staking, lending, and validator deployment. Its core products include liquid staking with sAVAX, which allows users to stake AVAX while maintaining liquidity, and lending/borrowing services that facilitate interest earnings on digital assets. The platform features two primary markets: Core Markets for highly liquid assets and Avalanche Ecosystem Markets for a wider range of assets, ensuring specialized risk management. Additionally, BENQI provides Ignite, a solution for easily launching Avalanche validators with minimal upfront costs, catering to both short-term and long-term use cases.
